Original source scope was queried after the native callback, not fenced to its entering upload.

Every overlapping original game c64 setter gets a unique generation before invoking the native D3D9 call; original producer identity is sampled across that native boundary.

R84 raw game-WVP registry accepts a split or full C993 upload only when its native callback remains the authoritative generation, preserving later reentrant producers and the R33 original single-draw fallback.
subcomponents: Add pure C++ source-stamp comparison for direct C993 call/pose/shader/draw and game-upload generation.
Wire generation and pre/post source fences into the real game c64 setter's split/full semantic paths; do not clear or relabel nested successful uploads from a stale outer callback.
Execute positive and mutation/negative C++ regression under the mandatory x64 host build, retain all Win32 R84/R26_SAFE and other required GitHub exact-SHA Gates.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Source-review-confirmed ordering in SetVertexShaderConstantFDest; native-hook reentrancy remains a deterministic regression scenario, not an observed Quest3 cause.
alternatives_rejected: Do not add duplicate C993 source hook, flatten world centre into head-locked HUD, alter alpha or remove verified CABE halo/SkyGlow.
